description: DUT silently discards a SYN with multicast IP destination (RFC 1122 §3.2.1.3 — multicast addresses are not legal connection destinations)
approach:
[Objective]
TCP is a unicast protocol; receiving a SYN aimed at a multicast group address is nonsensical and could be an attack. DUT must drop without response.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with multicast dst_ip.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT respond (no SYN,ACK).

[Pass condition]
No DUT response.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — first probe handshake never completed (anchors prelude)
• Fail_unexpected_ack — DUT acked the multicast-dst SYN

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently dropped multicast-dst SYN — normal
